verdict.rationale: Jeeves's documented invoice features are all accounts-payable: paying invoices, approval flows, bill-pay review and invoice scanning to capture recipient details. Nothing shows creating or sending branded invoices to customers with built-in payment collection. The Boleto API, which creates Brazilian payment slips, is a developer building block rather than a branded invoicing feature, and receiving funds into multi-currency accounts is an adjacent capability, so neither counts.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can create and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection
